name: West Virginia

law.name: Uniform Athlete Agents Act (W. Va. Code 30-39)

covers_nil_agents: Yes. The act covers endorsement contracts. The state NIL law lets athletes hire an athlete agent for NIL, and says that means an agent registered under 30-39 (W. Va. Code 18B-22-1, 18B-22-2).
contract_warning: Warning to student-athlete. If you sign this contract: (1) you may lose your eligibility to compete as a student-athlete in your sport; (2) if you have an athletic director, within 72 hours after entering into this contract, both you and your athlete agent must notify your athletic director; and (3) you may cancel this contract within 14 days after signing it. Cancellation of this contract may not reinstate your eligibility.
summary: Register online with the Secretary of State. $50.

steps.text: Apply on the WV licensing portal
Don't contact athletes until you're registered
Register with each school's compliance office, if it asks
steps.detail: Most schools have their own agent sign-up.

steps.text: Use a signed, written contract with all required items
steps.detail: Your pay and how it's figured, anyone else being paid, expenses, services, length and date signed.

steps.text: Put the warning to student-athlete box next to their signature
steps.detail: It must be in bold capital letters. Use the state's wording.

steps.text: Give the athlete a copy when they sign
Tell the athletic director in writing within 72 hours of signing
steps.detail: Or before the athlete's next game, if that comes first. The athlete must tell the athletic director too.

steps.text: Let the athlete cancel within 14 days of signing
steps.detail: They don't owe you anything if they cancel. They can't give up this right.

steps.text: Date the contract the day it's signed
steps.detail: State law and federal law (SPARTA) ban pre-dating or post-dating it.
Names and addresses, contracts and recruiting costs. The Secretary of State can inspect them.

steps.text: Never give the athlete anything of value before they sign
steps.detail: Don't give anything to anyone else to get them to sign, except another registered agent. Never lie or make false promises.

watch_list.item: Federal Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (S.4668)
watch_list.status: Passed the Senate on Sept 28, 2026. The House is out until Nov 9 and leaders say it won't pass as-is. It dies if not enacted by Jan 3, 2027.
watch_list.impact: It would require every NIL agent to register in a state, cap agent fees at 5% of an endorsement deal and limit contracts to the athlete's eligibility.

review_notes: No phone number for athlete agent questions was found on the Secretary of State's pages. Get it from the licensing division at sos.wv.gov.
